title: Reference Wording Shapes Retrieval of Robot Task Instructions
abstract: arXiv:2610.17549v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identifying a robot task from a short instruction is sensitive to which descriptions are available for retrieval. We investigate this effect in the natural-language instructions included with the RLBench manipulation benchmark. We extract 296 fixed descriptions from 62 publicly available task files and compare five training-free lexical rankers over 80 random choices of one indexed description per task. Exact strings assigned to conflicting task labels are excluded from the primary score. Character n-gram TF-IDF achieves 61.3% mean top-1 accuracy on the resulting held-out instructions, compared with 55.6% for BM25 and 54.9% for word TF-IDF. Across gallery choices, character TF-IDF ranges from 55.2% to 66.8%; its 5th-95th percentile range is 56.9%-64.8%. translated_title: 参考措辞决定机器人任务指令的检索效果
translated_abstract: 从简短指令中识别机器人任务对可用于检索的描述内容十分敏感。我们在RLBench操作基准所附带的自然语言指令中研究了这一效应。我们从62个公开可用的任务文件中提取了296条固定描述，并在每个任务随机选择一条索引描述的80种组合上，比较了五种无需训练的词汇排序方法。分配给冲突任务标签的精确字符串被排除在主要评分之外。字符n-gram TF-IDF在所得的留出指令上达到了61.3%的平均top-1准确率，相比之下BM25为55.6%，词级TF-IDF为54.9%。在不同的参考库选择下，字符TF-IDF的准确率在55.2%至66.8%之间波动；其第5至第95百分位区间为56.9%-64.8%。添加第二条索引描述使字符TF-IDF在匹配查询上的性能提升了7.0个百分点。这些结果量化了参考措辞与表示方式选择所产生的影响。
tldr: 该论文在RLBench基准上通过80种随机参考库组合系统比较五种免训练词汇检索方法，首次量化了参考描述措辞与表示方式对机器人任务指令检索准确率的显著影响，发现字符n-gram TF-IDF表现最佳，且增加索引描述可带来7个百分点的提升。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares five training-free lexical rankers across 80 random reference-gallery selections on RLBench, quantifying for the first time how reference wording and representation choices significantly affect robot task instruction retrieval, with character n-gram TF-IDF performing best and a second indexed description yielding a 7.0 percentage-point improvement.
